period_note: Recovered via a Wayback Machine capture of DSE's OWN company page (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK), NOT the bank's site. This vintage of the table (titled 'Interim Financial Performance: <year>', 2016 onward) gives Turnover/Revenue, Profit for the period, Basic EPS and period-end market price, with Q2/Q3 given BOTH as a discrete quarter figure AND a separate cumulative (Half Yearly / 9 Months) figure side by side -- identical table structure to the one already documented for RUPALIBANK. Sourced from DSE's (dsebd.org) own company-page interim table, NOT the bank's own site (pubalibangla.com, Cloudflare-blocked). Solo/Standalone basis presumed, consistent with this bank's established series basis, but not explicitly labeled solo vs consolidated on the DSE page itself -- flagged as an assumption, not a confirmed fact (same caveat documented for RUPALIBANK's use of this identical source type). THIN/FLAGGED QUARTER, mirroring RUPALIBANK's own FY2021 Q3 finding exactly: the source table's Q3 column for Turnover/Profit/Total-Comprehensive-Income all read a plain (unflagged) 0, not credible as three unrelated genuine reported zeros for a bank that had just reported ~1.85bn cumulative profit through H1 -- treated as 'not disclosed to DSE in this structured field' and omitted. The 9-Months cumulative versions of these same rows carry DSE's own explicit tooltip: 'Mismatch is due to issuers own actual disclosure' -- also omitted. Turnover additionally excluded per this year's separate instability finding (see 2021_Q1.json). The ONE genuinely distinct, credible, non-zero, non-flagged figure for Q3 is EPS Basic = 2.720 -- recorded below. The flagged 9-Months cumulative EPS (4.520) is OMITTED from line_items per the RUPALIBANK precedent of excluding any tooltip-flagged cell regardless of arithmetic, though for the record it reconciles exactly (1.800 Half-Yearly + 2.720 this quarter = 4.520). Market price at period end (25.2) is clean/unflagged and recorded.
